Author: @crit7514
Content: I still cannot fathom that Plant would say that. I've been a, it feels like, life long fan of his work, hell I grew up on Plantana and Grow A Pair... When I wasn't watching his movies I was watching interviews of him and the missus. I never noticed any animosity there, and definitely never something that would warrant such a vile outburst. You know, I really truly looked up to that plant, when I was but a wee seedling I wanted nothing but to be like Plant, or at least I would strive to be as close as possible. I saw Plant as not just a good plant, but a fascinating specimen who attracted and caught anyones attention when he entered the room. Well, I guess that's what I get for putting anyone on a pedestal. It just felt really nice and comforting to know that somewhere out there, between all that nastiness that can seem so overwhelming, was something pure and good. Someone who can live in all of this mess for me, so that I can accept and be happy with not being perfect. And I suppose I knew that this was warping reality, but there also was never really any point in questioning it, right? It just worked, he was perfect, made good movies and I could sometimes get a glimpse of his perfect life. Now that this has been pried away from me as well, where am I to go? I can't linger in this shadow unless I warp reality one more time, and truly merge with his shadow. But I think not. I think it's time for me to truly step into the sunlight, to feel its warmth and it's sting as well. I think I finally see that there is no true life without the pain as well. It has to rain sometimes for the plants to grow, and only in challenging times are we moulded into what we are, how we react, how we follow through, how we come out the other side, it's what shapes us. It's a tiresome task, and no doubt that sometimes I will long for the coolness of the shadow, but the reward for being out, being in the sun, is that despite the hardships I get to shape my own path, take my own choices. These will never be perfect, sometimes far from it, but at least it's my own, at least I have the control and bravery to take it that I longed for as a kid. So no more pedestals, no more relying on other people to live my own life. From here on out I will build no altars, but water only true relations with people I've seen and judged with my own eyes. Trust and understanding is not to be given freely, but rather earned, sown and tended to. The world is a complex place, and now more than ever we are bombarded with information from all sides, few of whose motives are clear, and expected to fall into the rabidhole. But I strive to be my own person now. I will make my mind up, no one else.

Author: @TheSkootenbeeten
Content:
At 03:14, I was completely sold on a deliberate edit by the likes of Lixian (if he has indeed edited this video), all to tie in to the aforementioned dying of Mark's computer (aforementioned by Mark, I mean). What did I witness that gave me such conviction? A flashback to the very beginning of the video. "Boo!" I heard. Over and over again. Mark's handsome face RIGHT UP on the screen, there. Until this 'edit' started to get old! "Boo," Mark kept saying. It was getting a little scary, but I knew this was only a joke, a caper, a jape. However, "Okay, that's quite enough..." I said to myself, "...seriously, it's time to get to the punchline of the joke." I concluded.
What actually happened was that I had my left hand hovering over my keyboard. The middle and index fingers of said hand were gently resting on the 9 and 0 keys, respectively. The index finger was a little less gentle, though. Owing (I have no doubt) to this finger having had more use than the other and, therefore, naturally curling up in its state of rest.
T'was at this moment (the "seriously, it's time to get to the punchline of the joke." moment) that I pressed my middle finger down on the 9 key. Only to see hitherto unseen moments from the video!
Yep. This was a long-winded way of saying, "I discovered the use of the number keys (1-0) on the keyboard when watching YouTube. 1 will take you to 10% of the way in, 2 to 20%, 3 to 30%, etc. Something I (up until now) had no idea of.
0 will take you... TO THE BEGINNING! What key was my overused, tendinopathy-stricken index finger resting upon? THE 0 KEY!

Uhm. Anyhoo. I shall now enjoy the rest of the video. Cherio.

EDIT: Seems Lixian INDEED DID edit this! Errrrrrrrm. Ok. Bye.
